description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) EMPEROR'S DOMAIN (Honoured Companions, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test; the pile-ins end, every owed fight is marked resolved and END_FIGHT reaches the Consolidate step (the fights themselves are not under test). The player real-clicks Custodian Guard A's row (engaged with the Boyz, on obj_center) in the Consolidate step panel: unit_selected_to_consolidate opens; a real click on Use spends 1 CP and the consolidation is made in OBJECTIVE mode (an engaged unit would otherwise have to make its engagement consolidation).
